recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多顆前紅血球母細胞與早期顆粒球前驅細胞的細胞質邊緣聚集小圓形空泡 (cytoplasmic vacuoles)，並可見形狀不規則的晚期紅血球母細胞，呈銅缺乏 (copper deficiency) 常見的紅系與骨髓系空泡化。
features: Large proerythroblasts and early granulocytic precursors with clusters of small clear vacuoles at the cytoplasmic periphery
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm in erythroid precursors with fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli
A promyelocyte/myelocyte with granules and prominent vacuoles (center)
Late erythroblasts with irregular nuclear contours and a cluster of dysplastic-appearing erythroid cells (bottom center)
Few mature neutrophils and a band form; an eosinophil precursor at right
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows left-shifted erythropoiesis in which proerythroblasts contain multiple small cytoplasmic vacuoles, together with late erythroblasts showing irregular nuclear contours consistent with dyserythropoiesis. Granulocytic precursors are also left-shifted and include vacuolated promyelocytes and myelocytes, with relatively few mature neutrophils. Blasts are not increased in this field. The combination of erythroid and myeloid precursor vacuolation is consistent with acquired copper deficiency in the given clinical context; correlation with serum copper, ceruloplasmin and zinc is recommended.

ddx.vs: MDS shows persistent dysplasia with clonal cytogenetic or molecular abnormalities, while copper-deficiency changes reverse after copper repletion.
AML shows ≥20% blasts, whereas here maturing vacuolated precursors predominate without a blast population.
Toxic vacuolation is morphologically similar and is separated by exposure history and normal copper levels.
